notes.title: 1.1.0 Patch Update
notes.content:
Hello Chefs,

Patch 1.1.0 is here with some exciting additions and important fixes:

Czech and French language support has been added.

Fixed several issues related to the Recipe Generator.

notes.title: First Week Patch: Mise en Place Market, Save Fixes & More!
notes.content:
Hey Chefs,

Thank you once again for the incredible support during our launch week. We have crafted this first week’s patch based on your feedback and suggestions. We will continue to release weekly patches and hotfixes in the upcoming weeks to improve Sizzle & Stack. Your feedback, bug reports, and kind messages are invaluable in helping us shape and enhance Sizzle & Stack every day.

Here’s what’s included in this patch:

New Market: Mise en Place
A new market has been added to the game. It sells sub-ingredients like dough, tortilla, and tomato sauce, helping you increase efficiency in the kitchen.

Upgrade Shop Adjustments
Several upgrade prices and unlock conditions have been rebalanced. For example, the Pantry Box is now available after Day 2, and the Pan Upgrade can be obtained from the start of the game.

Recipe Card Drop Rate Increased
Recipe cards now drop more frequently from packs to support smoother progression.

Save File Corruption Fix
A bug that could corrupt save files after extended runs has been fixed.

Localization Optimization Fix
Performance issues caused by the localization system in languages other than English have been resolved.

Sous-Chef and Waiter Fixes
Multiple bugs related to Sous-Chef and Waiter behavior have been addressed for more stable automation.

Food Magnet Bug Fix
A bug caused by the Food Magnet system has been resolved.

General Optimization Improvements
Several issues causing drastic FPS drops have been identified and fixed.
[hr][/hr]
We’re still in our first week, and we’re committed to making continuous improvements. If you experience issues or have suggestions, please don’t hesitate to share them with us on Discord. Your feedback truly helps guide our next steps.

Discord Link: https://discord.gg/QsPs24HuVu


Thank you for being part of this journey,
The Sizzle & Stack Team

notes.title: 🔥 First Hotfix Patch is Here!
notes.content:
Hey Chefs,

Thank you so much for the incredible support on our very first release day. Your feedback, kind words, and bug reports mean the world to us—and they've already helped shape this first hotfix.

This is our first release week, and it’s normal to encounter some bugs. But we’re more than ready to tackle them as you report them. These hotfixes will continue in the coming weeks as we keep improving the experience together.

Here’s what’s been fixed and improved in this patch:

Fixed performance and optimization issues caused by a font bug in the Chinese localization system.

Dish, ingredient, and tool cards can now stack with each other properly. This also resolves stacking issues with cupboard and fridge cards.

Addressed several bugs related to the Food Magnet.

Recipe Book will now display recipe names in alphabetical order by default.

Increased the drop rate of Recipe cards from packs.

We’ll keep cooking improvements based on your feedback—so keep them coming!

With love,
The Sizzle & Stack Team 🧑‍🍳

notes.title: Quality-of-Life Boost & Bug Fix Hotfix Patch
notes.content:
Hello Chefs!

Patch 0.4.2 is here and it’s packed with fresh content, helpful improvements, and important fixes. We’ve added new customer faces, enhanced your control settings, and upgraded the kitchen experience overall. Let’s dig in 👇


🍽 New Content & Features
Camera Control Update Move the camera with right-click, and drag cards with left-click. This prevents accidental camera movement while handling cards.

WASD Movement Prefer keyboard controls? WASD movement is now supported for camera control.

Kitchen Expansion Upgrades
Kitchen upgrades are now split into multiple tiers, offering a smoother, more rewarding path to expansion.

Resolution Settings Adjust the screen resolution to fit your device and preferences.

Tool Upgrade Icons
Upgrade visuals in the shop are now clearer and more polished, helping you make smarter upgrade choices.

Recipe Book Navigation
We’ve added smooth tween animations to the recipe book for a more pleasant browsing experience.

Custom Cursor
You can now personalize your cursor with a stylish hand icon via the settings menu.

Reset All Progress Button Want to start over? A single-click reset option is now available in the settings.

New Customer Faces Some new guests have arrived — see if you can spot them in the queue!
[hr][/hr]🛠 UI & Visual Improvements
Vertical Scroll Restored
Both the Recipe Book and Shop View now scroll properly.

Shop Max Limit Text
A helpful indicator shows when you've reached the purchase cap in the shop.

Shadow Improvements
Shadows and layering have been refined for cleaner item visuals.
[hr][/hr]🐞 Bug Fixes & Hotfixes
Fixed an issue with customer layout when more than 3 arrived at once.

Pot has been re-added to the Food Truck pack.

Resolved several tooltip, text, and mesh sorting bugs for a smoother experience.

Adjusted the pot spoilage system — pots no longer expire unexpectedly.

Plus, various minor bug fixes and backend improvements to keep the game stable.
[hr][/hr]
Thanks as always for your feedback and support!
If you run into any issues or want to share ideas, drop by our \[Discord server] — we’d love to hear from you. Let’s keep making this kitchen even better 🔥

– The Sizzle & Stack Team

notes.title: Demo Update #3 - Ahead of Next Fest! 🍽️
notes.content:
Hey Chefs!

We’re beyond excited to share our biggest update yet for Sizzle & Stack—just in time for Next Fest! This patch brings a full serving of new features, UI improvements, balance tweaks, and quality-of-life updates, all crafted from your feedback and our vision for the game.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592878/d1d109f038aca18922703e83c5f968617f5e1f7f.png"]

Whether you’ve played the demo before or you’re jumping in for the first time, this is the best time to fire up the stove and see what’s new!

Here’s what’s coming to the kitchen:
Major Updates
Market Stations: Market Stations are a new type of station card that lets you buy specific ingredients—for a higher price. During the recent beta tests, we noticed that finding certain ingredients, especially from early packs, was becoming tedious. These new stations are designed to make it easier to find exactly what you need to cook.

There are 5 types of Market Stations: Pantry Market, Vegetable Market, General Store 1, General Store 2, and the Seafood Market.

Designed to reduce frustration and give more control over your runs.

Event Cards: If you played the demo or beta, you’re probably familiar with Rent Days. Based on your feedback, we saw that Rent Days felt too sudden, and the rent amounts were unclear. 

Now, event cards will appear on your table when a specific event is approaching. For example, Rent Day will show up with a countdown and let you know exactly how much you need to pay.

Event cards open up a whole new layer of gameplay, and we plan to expand them with even more fun challenges.

A New Event: We’ve also added a brand-new event: Health Inspection. If you let more than 10 garbage cards pile up on your table, you’ll receive a warning. Fail to clean it up in time, and you’ll be fined.

Upgrade Shop UI Overhaul: The Upgrade Shop is one of the most important parts of Sizzle & Stack, and it finally got the love it deserves. We’ve completely redesigned the UI to make it more readable, more navigable, and far more intuitive.

All upgrade options now have custom icons.

Purchase states and availability are clearly marked.

No more guesswork—you’ll know exactly what you’re getting and when.

Character Animations: Your restaurant just got a lot livelier. We’ve added new animations to give your quirky customers more personality. You’ll now see them react in real time: whether they’re happily munching on their food, storming off in disappointment, or just taking it all in.

It’s a small touch, but one that adds warmth and soul to every order served.

All Recipe Packs Now Unlockable: As you progress in your run, you’ll now be able to unlock four brand-new content packs: Mexican Flame, Turkish Cuisine, Asian Delicacy, and Royal Banquet. (This update will be experienced only in the beta version of the game due to the limited number of days of the demo version)

Each pack introduces a new set of dishes, ingredients, and recipe combinations—bringing more variety, challenge, and flavor to your kitchen.
Quality-of-Life Improvements
This update also includes several enhancements to improve moment-to-moment gameplay:

Sell Area Repositioned: It’s now in a more accessible and visually clean spot. Selling is faster and smoother than ever.

Spoil Indicator Upgrade: This is a brand-new upgrade that adds a visual layer to ingredient and dish cards, showing how soon they’ll spoil—no more accidental garbage buildup!

Kitchen Expansion Increased: You can now expand your table to support up to 100 cards—perfect for players who love juggling complex setups.

Card Hover Highlight: We’ve added a subtle hover effect to help you clearly see which card you’re about to pick up with your mouse.
Bug Fixes & Minor Updates
Improved ultra-wide resolution support in the main menu

Added main menu visual effects

UI text fixes in the shop

Fixed issues with the Mission System

Multiple balance and economy adjustments
Our Roadmap to Full Release
With this update, we’re also sharing our official roadmap—a look at all the exciting features we’re planning to bring to Sizzle & Stack before the full release later this year.



[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdSoNRadL8CRgSFRG_stUrUs2XutcaH2_kffrgZl53hylMOLghugdUKQFKWbKlyWM_zZRx12cDS-eUn5qRKzuMK9DwvwHq6xRLxpmAlNO2lNkZulGcBmaM_DTMIgJtEByMDsM8phg?key=LrBpwxGOGYbEzDD7KI9srA"]

These include:

Employee Cards to help you automate your kitchen

Upgraded Tools to boost efficiency in the heat of cooking

Rogue-like Progression with adaptive difficulty and choices

Full Mod Support to let the community create and share their own content

A complete Endgame System Rework, including improvements to Sizzle Medals

We’re building toward something special, and we hope you’ll continue to shape it with us.

Thank you again for being part of this journey. Your feedback, reviews, and wishlist support mean the world to us. Let us know what you think of the update—and as always, feel free to hop into our Discord and share your thoughts directly with the devs and other players.

See you in the kitchen!

-Sizzle & Stack Team

notes.title: Demo Update #2 — Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey there, Chefs!

Another week, another update for the Sizzle & Stack demo. Thank you so much to everyone who has supported us with feedback and bug reports. We've been hard at work fixing the issues you've encountered and improving the overall user experience.
We'll continue updating the demo until release, so please keep the feedback coming! 😊

Patch Notes:
* Learning a recipe now unlocks all its sub-recipes in the Recipe Book. (e.g. Learning "Basic Burger" also adds "Patty" to your Recipe Book.)
* With the Kitchen Expansion update, your table area will gradually grow.
* Difficulty Settings added:
    * Adjustable day length.
    * Hardcore Mode now available (no Pause allowed!).
* New cooking fire VFX added.
* Background music implemented.
* Font updated for better readability.
* Pack costs increased for better balance.
* Order sell values now shown in tooltips.
* Day End Report UI updated.
* Wait time indicator added for next customers.
* General economy balancing.
* Full UI overhaul.
* Customer arts tweaked for a better look.
* Some recipes have been updated or reworked.

Bug Fixes:
* Daily Report no longer appears over the Upgrade Shop.
* Save system issues resolved.
* Day counter no longer starts before opening the “First Steps” pack.
* Shop sorting issue fixed.
* Customer reroll UI now appears correctly.

⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTICE
With this update, your save files will be deleted.
However, we’ll be deploying a beta branch for the current version. If you’d like to continue your existing run, you can switch to the beta version 0.2.0 and pick up where you left off.

Thanks again for all your support — your feedback is helping shape Sizzle & Stack into the coziest chaos-filled kitchen card game ever.

👉 Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/QsPs24HuVu

Stay saucy, The Arvis Games Team 🧑‍🍳

notes.title: Demo Update #1 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey chefs! 👩‍🍳🔥

We’ve just rolled out a brand-new Sizzle & Stack demo update on Steam—our most refined build yet!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592878/edcda862cd3a2a6d5de19d87da701b101ffc453e.jpg
Have you met Sizzy?

This update is packed with meaningful improvements, added polish, and exciting new content—all shaped by your generous feedback over the past weeks. If you’ve played before, we’d love for you to return and see how far we’ve come. And if you’re just discovering the game… welcome to the joyful chaos of card-based cooking in a cozy urban fantasy kitchen!

 Main Menu Implemented: A brand-new main menu has been added for smoother navigation and a more polished first impression.
 SFXs Added: New sound effects enhance the feel of cooking, card interactions, and more—your kitchen has never sounded better.

notes.title: Dev Diary #1 — The First Orders Are In
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I’m Alper Nargileci, game designer and product lead of Sizzle & Stack, and I’m incredibly excited to write the first chapter of our developer diary.

Sizzle & Stack is a fast-paced, card-based cooking simulator where deck-building meets restaurant chaos. Inspired by Stacklands, this unique twist on the culinary genre puts you in charge of a growing kitchen where every dish, upgrade, and decision is made with cards. The amazing game, Stacklands, heavily inspires it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592878/ad007131ee371c604089368467f184e902a084b4.png

Right now, our demo is in Steam review, and it’ll be live in just a few days. It’s surreal to say that. What started as a small prototype—about cooking, cards, and creative chaos—has grown into something we truly believe in.

We came together as a team with one goal: to make something cozy, joyful, and lasting. Sizzle & Stack is set in a charming urban fantasy world, where magic simmers just beneath the surface of every meal. It’s a game about rhythm, decision-making, and discovering strange new recipes in a world that feels warm, weird, and wonderfully alive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592878/62f3853589b34e888d868dacfaf25726f528b30e.png

This is also a big personal milestone for us: it will be our first finished project on Steam. That alone is a reason to celebrate—but more than that, we’ve built this game with the long-term in mind. Sizzle & Stack isn’t just a quirky card game about cooking. It’s designed to be an everlasting game—moddable, expandable, and constantly growing with its community. We want this game to stay fresh long after launch, shaped by your ideas as much as ours.

Right now, we’re in the feedback gathering phase. That means your impressions, comments, bug reports, and chaotic kitchen stories are gold to us. Tell us what works. Tell us what breaks. Tell us if you accidentally deep-fried a banana and set your station on fire. Every insight you share in comments helps us refine the experience.

We’re thrilled to be part of Steam Next Fest in June 2025, where we’ll showcase a polished, updated version of the demo based on your feedback. And yes—we’re planning to launch the full game shortly after the festival.

We’re especially excited to confirm: modding will be fully supported. From custom cards and new ingredients to full-on content packs, we’re building the game to be a platform for creativity.

And none of this could’ve happened without the brilliant, passionate team behind it:
- Bilal Aydın – Developer
- Mesut Usta – Developer
- Zeynep Çıvgış aka Zeze – Illustrator
- Barış Yalçın – UI/UX Artist, SFXs
- Elif Kaya – Animation VFXs, 3D VFXs
- Berna Güney – QA Lead

And a huge thank you to the entire Arvis Games team. We shared this journey together, cooked it together, and served it together.

So what’s next?
Wishlist the game, give the demo a spin when it drops, and tell us how it feels. Sizzle & Stack is our love letter to cozy chaos, and we can’t wait to share it with you.

Until next time,
Alper Nargileci
Game Designer & Product Lead, Sizzle & Stack
